scope: Closed cooperative transport probe, NOT TC0 semantics or machine determinism

framing.header: canonical decimal byte length followed by LF
framing.payload: canonical compact sorted-key ASCII JSON followed by LF

closure: Only exact published record shapes/values and canonical wire bytes accepted; alternate escapes/key order, duplicate keys, numeric tokens, BOM, unknown fields/kinds rejected
diagnostics: Guest launched with --solo5:quiet: allowed stdout diagnostic prefix is EMPTY. Unexpected stdout bytes anywhere fail closed. Bounded stderr retained separately, never normalized into semantic records.
terminal: Guest emits Terminal only after two responses, requires exact Ack and input EOF, then exit0/output EOF; early terminal/EOF/suffix rejected
assumptions: No guest clock APIs used by this probe
Stock binding startup CPU ticks and allowed clock syscalls remain uncontrolled
No complete semantic evaluator isolation or qualified language claim
